title: SonnetDB 连接配置
description: 连接 SonnetDB 5.0 并按 tools/list 发现43工具。默认使用目标库 Read 最小权限令牌；仅在用户已明确授权写入时使用适当 Write grant。工具存在不等于写授权。
description_en: Discover the 43 SonnetDB 5.0 tools through tools/list. Default to a target-database Read token; use an appropriate Write grant only for explicitly authorized writes. Discovery does not grant write permission.
docLabel: 查看 SonnetDB Agent 接入指南

fields.label: SonnetDB 主机及可选端口
fields.description: 仅填写主机及可选端口，不含协议、路径、@、用户名或密码。连接固定使用 HTTPS，证书须有效。
fields.description_en: Enter only host and optional port, without scheme, path, @ or credentials. HTTPS with a valid certificate is required.

fields.label: 目标数据库名
fields.description: 填写已存在的目标数据库名，默认 Read；已获用户明确写授权时使用该库 Write grant。不填 URL、斜杠、查询串或片段。
fields.description_en: Enter an existing target database, defaulting to Read. Explicitly authorized writes also require its Write grant. Do not enter a URL, slash, query or fragment.

fields.label: SonnetDB Bearer Token
fields.placeholder: 默认目标库 Read；已授权写操作才使用 Write 凭据
fields.description: 凭证仅填此字段，不进入提示词、SQL、日志或仓库。默认最小 Read；用户已明确授权写入才使用对应 Write grant。工具发现不是授权。轮换后更新配置，撤销旧令牌应返回 HTTP 401。
fields.description_en: Use this field only; never include credentials in prompts, SQL, logs or source control. Default to minimum Read; use Write only for explicitly authorized writes. Tool discovery is not authorization. Update after rotation; revoked tokens must receive HTTP 401.
